payload.context: Tides are the regular rise and fall of sea levels caused by the gravitational forces exerted by the Moon and the Sun combined with the rotation of the Earth. The Moon's gravity is the dominant force driving tides because, despite its smaller mass, it is much closer to Earth than the Sun. Spring tides occur when the Sun, Moon, and Earth align, and neap tides occur when they form a right angle.
